'''Law and crime'''
*[[Homelessness in California]]
**In the [[United States]], [[Governor of California]] [[Gavin Newsom]] signs an executive order directing state agencies on how to remove [[Tent city|homeless encampments]] throughout [[California|the state]]. *[[Human rights in Cambodia]]
**[[Candlelight Party]] President Teav Vannol is fined 6 billion [[Cambodian riel|riel]] (US$1.5 million) for "defamation" of the current [[Politics of Cambodia|Cambodian government]] to foreign media following his party being barred from the [[2023 Cambodian general election|2023 general election]], which saw the incumbent [[Cambodian People's Party|People's Party]] win 120 of 125 [[National Assembly (Cambodia)|National Assembly]] seats. **The twenty new members of the [[General Council of the Judiciary]] are sworn in, putting an end to the institutional crisis that the country's supreme judicial administrative body experienced for five years.
